response.sql: SELECT AVG(invoice_mean_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(li.product_price) AS invoice_mean_price, COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) AS invoice_summary
